item.title: PM Modi, during Jerusalem visit, highlights Israel’s innovative tech scene, showcasing AI and healthcare
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Jerusalem and highlighted Israel’s innovative tech scene, showcasing AI, Quantum, healthcare, and more. item.description: JAMMU: The Office of the District Magistrate, Poonch, has ordered the reopening of the Mughal Road (NH-701A) stretch from Bufliaz to Peer Ki Gali for Light Motor Vehicles (LMVs).
